name: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 10
summary:
One-Button Games 5-in-1 | Vol. 10 is a compilation of five fast-paced arcade games that can only be controlled with one button. Every microgame released under these compilations explore different genres, from endless jumpers and platformers to rhythm tower defense.

(FLIPBOMB) What if the last line of defense from a meteor shower was... a pinball flipper? In FLIPBOMB, you'll control a single flipper and your balls will be rolling bombs destined for those pesky meteors falling down the sky! You'll have to calculate the angle of the shot and hit the flip. The bombs will detonate when they hit a meteor and create a chain reaction. You'll rack up more points the longer the chain is. You will lose if a meteor escapes your line or hits the flipper.

(MONJUM) Let's take a relaxing walk on the moon and... uh-oh! The moon has been invaded with wretched things! MONJUM has you jumping over platforms in an endless scroller while avoiding monsters and picking up coins. Charging your jump will have you stop moving so calculate the jump as precise as you can. You'll win extra points if you jump over a minion and pick a coin with a single move. Don't get touched by any monster or fall on a crater, or it's game over!

(FROM TWO SIDES) Prepare to avoid danger... from two sides! You'll have to quickly swap directions and avoid the spike walls coming from both the top and bottom side. Tap to turn, hold to speed up, and teleport from left and right by going off the edge of the screen. Points are cumulative with the amount of walls you avoid. You'll lose if you touch a spike.

(HEXMIN) Feel the rhythm and pulse up in HEXMIN to protect the system's core! There are malware bytes rushing to attack the pulsating hexa-core and 4 of your 6 firewalls are down. Tap to rotate the firewalls and stop the malware dead on its tracks. Accumulate points by stopping attackers. The game is over if the core gets hits.

(JUJUMP) Can the green slime make that jump? Only one way to know: Ju-ju-ju-jump! JUJUMP is an endless jumper where you have to calculate the distance of your jumps as well as your horizontal velocity, because it's more than possible you're not able to reach the next platform. Collect coins to increase your score and try to reach the highest score. You'll lose if you fall to the ground or go out the edge!
